name: devflow
description: State-based agent development protocol for repository-grounded planning, one-item execution, independent audits, and deterministic handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, execute, audit, and resume agentic development
interface.longDescription: A state-based protocol for approved-PRD delivery and phase-free brownfield audit/remediation. It plans repository-grounded WORK, executes one verified change at a time, and applies machine-readable integration audit outcomes without autonomous orchestration.
defaultPrompt: Execute the next DevFlow work item.
Audit and remediate this brownfield codebase through a phase-free DevFlow integration audit.
